svg.title: Ratings are mostly the song, alpha is mostly the person. 105 exploratory tests: 3 uncorrected hits, about 5 expected by chance, 0 survived correction.

section.h2: Ratings are mostly the song. Alpha is mostly the person.

div.span: song to song, within a person 6%

section.p: There is plenty of personal feeling in the ratings, especially for valence. But any emotional effect in the brain had to show up in alpha’s thin 6% slice, alongside alertness, fatigue and attention.

section.h2: 105 more places to look. Nothing beyond chance.

div.aria-label: Grid of 105 exploratory tests: 5 frequency bands by 7 scalp regions by 3 ratings. Three tests passed an uncorrected threshold; none survived correction.

i.title: Valence, Right temporal, γ: uncorrected p < .05, did not survive correction
Arousal, Central, α: uncorrected p < .05, did not survive correction
Arousal, Central, β: uncorrected p < .05, did not survive correction
